Naturally, this rather crude projectile managed to breach Rook’s considerable resilience.
Naturally, one expects a degree of fire safety when one is required to endure such a grim existence.
Of course, this dim tableau scarcely does justice to my finest brushstrokes.
Naturally, one observes that Corin Vance is contemplating the crude end of things.
Of course, this mud is quite unsuitable for any artistic endeavor, my dear Rook.
Naturally, the sheer audacity to devour raw protein amidst this squalor is quite breathtaking.
Naturally, one would hope the destruction of fine sporting implements might inspire a modicum of decorum, my dear Rook.
Naturally, one can only hope that the cold will drive him toward a more appropriate burial.

Naturally, this patch of dirt offers a most unforgivable lack of suitable elevation for one's consumption, my dear.
Naturally, this jellied horror is a trifle beneath a palate accustomed to refinement, my dear Ash.
